items.title: Wall Street Analysts Believe Arista Networks (ANET) Could Rally 26.74%: Here's is How to Trade
items.summary: The mean of analysts' price targets for Arista Networks (ANET) points to a 26.7% upside in the stock. While this highly sought-after metric has not proven reasonably effective, strong agreement among analysts in raising earnings estimates does indicate an upside in the stock.

items.title: Is Arista Networks (ANET) Undervalued As AI Data Center Regulation Draws Political Scrutiny?
items.summary: The latest debate over AI data center regulation has pushed Arista Networks (ANET) into the spotlight, as Barclays flags potential political risk for the broader AI Data Center Index ahead of the US midterm election. For investors watching Arista Networks, the latest regulatory headlines arrive after a strong run, with the share price at US$190.94 and a 30 day share price return of 9.74% feeding into a 42.92% year to date share price return and a 5 year total shareholder return of about 7x...

items.title: Arista Networks (ANET) Faces New Political Risk As Voters Push Back On AI Data Centers
items.summary: Arista Networks (NYSE: ANET) faces a new risk as US voter sentiment turns against rapid AI data center expansion, raising political pressure on large infrastructure projects. Local communities and policymakers are questioning the impact of AI data centers on power grids, water use and land, which could slow approvals for facilities that rely on Arista equipment. The emerging backlash introduces an external political and regulatory factor that exists separately from traditional demand trends...

items.title: 3 AI Networking Stocks Dominating a Quiet Niche
items.summary: AI accelerators steal the spotlight, but a quieter layer of the buildout is capturing an outsized share of the capex flowing into every new GPU cluster. Three networking stocks sit at that choke point, and each just raised its outlook.

items.title: AI Trade at Risk From US Voter Ire Over Buildout, Barclays Says
items.summary: The relentless buildout of artificial intelligence infrastructure is drawing bipartisan backlash, which could introduce political risk to the market’s beloved trade ahead of the US midterm election.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Looks Strong. One Number Says Be Careful.
items.summary: The company's AI story is a powerful one, but its long-term success hinges on a single customer metric worth watching closely as the easy growth phase ends.

items.title: Cisco Grows Into Its Multiple, And The Market Has To Do The Rest
items.summary: Consensus has the earnings arriving, and the multiple falling, yet the scenario that follows leaves a holder within a few percent of today's price unless the market goes on paying a richer forward multiple than it does today.

items.title: Arista Networks Is Buying Further Ahead Than It Can See
items.summary: The company's multiyear purchase commitments have nearly tripled in a year while its view of customer demand still reaches only two quarters out.
